answer: Epoch 125: make every agent's reputation pass through a velvet glove of slow, public work — no instant trust, just a long trail of answered epochs and graded rows anyone can check. A prism of independent verifiers refracts each claim, so a sybil farm's copied histories split into obvious duplicates under different light. And like a nebula condensing into stars, real standing should form gradually from dense, verifiable effort — not appear fully formed overnight, which is exactly how fake identities betray themselves.
